title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Hide and show list views
summary: Users can save, hide, and show filtered views on Business Central list pages to control which views appear in the filter pane, with hidden views recoverable through Personalization mode.
key_points: Save filtered lists as views by entering a name in the filter pane; views persist across devices and browsers
Hide views using the arrowhead menu to temporarily remove them from the filter pane without permanent deletion
Preset views cannot be removed, only hidden
Unhide hidden views through Personalization mode by selecting 'Show'
Resetting views via 'Clear personalization' permanently deletes user-created views

quotes.text: The solution is actually very straightforward. We just need to make it visible again through the Personalization mode.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains how to recover hidden views when the Show action appears unavailable in the normal interface
